name: Epoxy Resin & Epichlorohydrin: Domestic Chain Build-out Behind Anti-Dumping Duty
scope: India imports much of its epoxy resin (wind blades, electronics/laminates, coatings, composites) but is now adding domestic epichlorohydrin (ECH) and resin capacity behind a 5-year anti-dumping duty on liquid epoxy resin (Nov 2025): DCM Shriram's 52,000 tpa ECH fully on stream (Apr 2026), Grasim's 50,000 tpa ECH in commercial production (15 Nov 2026) next to its epoxy plant, Atul's resin at 80,000 tpa, and Epigral's board-approved Rs 600 cr / 125,000 tpa epoxy entry (Jul 2026, H2 FY28); early and thinly grouped by media, with Epigral de-rated (~-44% in 1 year) rather than re-rated, but mostly mid/large caps and the duty driver is about a year old.
questions: What is the epoxy resin chain (BPA + ECH -> liquid/solid epoxy -> hardeners/formulations) and which end markets (wind blades, CCL/electronics encapsulation, coatings, construction, composites) drive its demand growth, per market-research reports?
How large is India's epoxy resin, ECH and BPA import dependence today, and from which countries? Is BPA still a missing domestic link?

What did the anti-dumping duty on liquid epoxy resin (Notification 33/2025-Customs (ADD), 17 Nov 2025, five years, US$37-483/MT) change for domestic producers, and what are the sunset and pass-through risks?
What have DCM Shriram, Grasim and Epigral commissioned or planned in ECH (capacity, timing, raw material - glycerine vs propylene - and chlorine integration)?
What are Grasim, Atul and Epigral doing in epoxy resin itself (capacity, utilisation, product mix, qualification in wind/electronics grades)? Confirm each claim from filings.
How material is epoxy/ECH to each company's revenue and profit (Epigral vs Grasim vs Atul vs DCM Shriram), and is it a needle-mover for any?
Are there other listed Indian players (hardeners, formulators, BPA/phenol producers, small caps) with filed plans in the epoxy chain that clear the evidence bar?
Has the market priced this in? Stock performance over 6-12 months and broker/media coverage of the epoxy theme to date.
What are the risks: Chinese oversupply and price pressure, duty circumvention via other countries, ECH price cycles, project delays (Epigral H2 FY28), glycerine feedstock costs?
What are the near-term catalysts (Epigral ECH/CPVC commissioning within about a quarter, Grasim ECH ramp-up, wind and electronics demand, any BPA announcements, duty review)?

ech_feedstock: Domestic ECH producers - the key epoxy intermediate that India largely imported
epoxy_resin_producers: Companies already making epoxy resin and expanding or integrating backward
new_integrated_entrant: Companies with board-approved epoxy resin entry built on in-house ECH and chlor-alkali
